### Summary

In addition to the existing `--env-file` feature, Node also has [`--env-file-if-exists`](https://nodejs.org/api/cli.html#--env-file-if-existsfile), which does not throw an error if the given file does not exist. This is particularly useful in dev/lifecycle scripts/ci… e.g.
~~~ py
#! /usr/bin/env -S uv run --env-file-if-exists .env --script
import os
UV_ENV_FILE = os.getenv("UV_ENV_FILE", ".env")
exists = os.path.isfile(UV_ENV_FILE)
print(exists) # false
~~~
